translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Lázaro burgwisad
Dule-wargwen Lázaro-nugadi, Betaniagined, deun uelemaid. We-Betania-neggweburde María, degine, e-ior-Marta e-neggweburmogad.
We-María, gwallu-wawaadgi Bab-Jesús-magsa-gusad, na e-sailagiagi Dummad-Jesús-e-nag odingusii-gusadid. We-María-e-sus Lázaro deun uelemaid.
Degisoggu, Lázaro-e-bunmar dulemar-barmismalad, Jesúsga sogegar, Dummad, ar dule-nue-be-sabedi, uelemaiye.
Jesús, degi-itosgua, sogded: —We-Lázaro-uelemaidi, burgwegarsulid, Bab-Dummad-nug-odummogega we-uelemaid, adi we-uelemaidgi Bab-Dummad-Machi-e-nug odummolegegar.
Dakargua, Jesús, nue Marta, e-urba, degine, Lázaro-sabed.
Jesús wisgusgu, Lázaro uelemaiye, bia-na-maidgi ibabo amba megis-gusad.
Geb a-sorba, Jesús na e-sapinganga sokalid: —Gannar anmar Judease namarye.
E-sapingan ega sogded: —Odurdaked-saila, emide Judiomar akwagi be-makbi-gusmaladde, ¿degite gannar be nabarde?
Jesús, abin-sogded: —¿Ar neg-ibgined wachi-irambe-gakabo niksursi? Ar dule neg-ibgi gudiile, geg yoleged, ar we-napneggined neg-meegwadba gudiid.
Ar dule neg-mutikidgi gudiirdi, yoledo, ar agindi gwallu-meegwad sulid. An-burgoed-iba-nonikidse geb an burgoed, emigindi an-oburgosurmalad, ar ibginedyob an gudiid.
We-degi-sogsad-sorba Jesús na e-sapinganga sogdesunnad: —Anmar-ai-Lázaro gabmaid, an ese naer-gebed odakegar.
E-sapingan ega sogdemalad: —Dummad, ar Lázaro gabmaile, nuguodo. Degite, ¿ibiga be nabisunna? Mer be nae.
Ar Jesús we-degi-sogsa-gusadi, sognaindo: “Lázaro burgwar maiye.” Ar e-sapingandi, gabed-sunnad ega obarye bienad.
Geb degi Jesús bakar-buud sogdesunnad: —Lázaro burgwis maiye.
Bemar-ular yeer an itoged, ar Lázaro-walik an gudigussurgu, adi bemar mer angi bengumalagar. Degisoggu, anmar Lázarose namargwelo.
Degi Tomás, Dídimoye bimarbalid, e-sordamarga sogdesunnad: —Anmar Jesúsba namarmodo, adi anmar eba burgwemarmogagar.
Jesús dule-odurguedid, degine, burba-geg-bergued ukedid
Degi Jesús Betaniase nonigu, daknonikid, Lázaro ibabakegus bato neg-uangi digles-mai.
Betania dakargu Jerusaléngi itakaa siid, unnila wachi-abala nanae-wilub.
Lázaro-burgwisad-ular, Judiomar-bukidar Martase, degi, Maríase nonigusmalad, adi wis e-gwage odimakegar.
Marta itosgu Jesús daniye, e-abin nade-gusad, Maríadi neggi besa-gusad.
Degi Marta Jesúsga sogded: —Dummad, be wegi anmar-abargi gudigusana, an-sus burgwissulinad.
Emigi an wisbardo, ar ibu Bab Dummadse be egisele, Bab Dummad bega ukoed.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Be-sus gannar durguoed.
Marta, abin-sogded: —An wisi, ibagan-bergusar, an-sus dulemar-gannar-durguoed-ibagi gannar durguoed.
Jesús, abin-sogde: —Ani an gannar sunna dule-odurguedid, degi, ani an burba-geg-bergued ukedbalid. Ar dule angi bensulile, ar burgwar mai-inigwele, gannar durguoed.
Ar bela-dula-gudidimalad angi bensulile, bar e-san-burba berguosulid, degi-sadeguoed. ¿Ar we an-bega-soged be bensuli?
Marta, Jesús-abin sogded: —Dummad, eye, an bensuli, be Cristo, Bab-Dummad-Machi, we-napnegse be danikoye be sogles-gusadid.
Jesús, Lázaro-neg-uangi bosad
Marta deyob sogsad-sorbali, e-urbase gornaded, ega arbakee sogdapid: —Odurdaked-saila noni, bese gole.
Deyob ega soge itosgu, María yog gwisguar imaksad, Jesússe nade-gusad.
Jesús deun amba yo neggweburse doged, ar bia-Marta-e-abingusadgi amba gudiid.
Judiomar wis María gwage odimakegala, e-neggi-eba-bukmaladi, daksamargu, María gwae gwisgus node, eba nodmarmogad. Amar sogdemalad: —María neg-uanse naded, ase bonaded.
María, Jesús-siidse modapgu, Jesús dakdegu, e-abin yokorgi sindigar sigdapid, ega sogded: —Dummad, be wegi anmar-abargi gudigusana, an-sus burgwissulinad.
Jesús dakdegu, María ise-boale, degine, Judiomar-wis-María-gwage-odimakega-nonimalad ise-boarmarmoga, na ulubgi nue-nunmak ito-nadmogad, degi, nue-María-wile-dakded.
Jesús Maríaga sogded: —¿Bia bemar Lázaro-digsamala? Jesúsga sogdemalad: —Dummad, be dage, be dakdage, bia digar mai.
Degi Jesús boded.
Degi Judiomar sogdemarsunnad: —Nue be dake, ibiyobi Jesús Lázaro-nue-sabena.
Degi Judio-baigan sogdemarmogad: —Ar we-Jesúsde, dule-ibya-sulidga ibya-egasadde, ¿ar sunna wede Lázaro oburgwesuli geg imakgussi? Deyob imake-wilubbinad.
Jesús, Lázaro-gannar-odurgusad
Jesús nue ulubgi bukib itodbargu, neg-uanse nonikid. Dakargua, gusgu na Judiomar mui digdamalad akwa-yaa-ollogwad-yaba, geb akwa-dummad e-doged-idu sii-damalad.
Jesús dulemarga sogdesunnad: —Akwa-dummad-onirmar. Marta, dule-burgwisad-e-bun, sogded: —Dummad, ¿Ibiga akwa be onirbie? Bato ibabakegus diglesad, degisoggu, ¿bato nun yapansursi?
Jesús, Marta-abin sogded: —¿An bega sogsasursi, be bensulile, Bab-Dummad-gangued be dakoye?
Degi geb bia dule-burgwisad-diglesadgi akwa-dummad-idu-siid onirismalad. Geb degi Jesús niba atakdegu, sogded: —Baba, dog-nuedye an bega soge, be an-itosgu.
Andi an wisid, be gusgu an-ito daed. Ar we-ibmar an sogsadi, dulemar-an-dikarba-bukwamalad-ular an sogsad, adi mer bengumalagar be an-barmialid.
Jesús degi-sogsad-sorbali, binnasur goted: —¡Lázaro, magaba be nodage!

Lázaro dule-burgwis-gusadi, noargu, bela naga, degine, arganmar morgo-bipirmakedgi ise-atinnar noalid, degine, e-wagar ise-morgogi bipirmakarbalid. Jesús dulemarga sogded: —Be Lázaro esikmar, degi, naega be imakmarsun.
Judio-dummagan Jesús-oburgwebi-gusmalad
Bukidar-Judiomar-Maríaba-nonimalad, Jesús Lázaro-gannar-odulosad daksamargu, Jesús-bensuli-gunonimalad.
Ar gwenna-gwennadi Fariseomarse nadmalad, ega sogdapmalad, igi Jesús Lázaro-odulosad.

Degine dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, degi, Fariseomar, amar igar-itogega dummagan-onmaknonimargu, sogdemalad: —¿Igi an samalosunna? Ar we-dule ibmar-wilubgan-imakdisulid bukidar emide imakdiid.
Ar we-Jesús ibmar-dakledisulid gatik imakega anmar imakmalale, bela eba nagudmaloed. Geb degi Roma-dummagan nonimaloed, anmar-Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg, degi, anmar-yar osulononimaloed.
Degi Judio-dummagan-wargwen, Caifás-nugadi, deun a-birgagi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-bur-dummadga gumaid, e-sordamarga sogded: —Bemar nue ibmar wichurmalad.
Ar bemar aku itomarsi, bela dulemar-anar dule-wargwen bur burgwed nabirid, adi melle bela dulemar-a-yargi-bukmalad obelolegegar.

We-Caifás degi-ibmar-sogsadi, na wargwen e-itolegedba ibmar sogsasulid, ar ade a-birgagi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-bur-dummadsoggu, iduakwaa sogsa-gusad: “Jesús bela Judio-dulemar-anar burgoye.”
Jesús unnila Judio-dulemar-anarbi burgosulid, burgwebaloed, adi bela Bab-Dummad-mimmigan aisakis-bukmalad na danakwaa urbegar.
Degisoggu, Judio-dummagan a-iba-akar na sogsamardo, Jesús-oburgwemaloye.

Degisoggu, Judiomar-abargi bar Jesús ise-na-san-oyoar gudigussulid. Judea-yargi node-gusad, naded, nega-dule-sulid-dikarba, neggwebur-Efraín-nugadse. Jesús a-neggweburgi na e-sapinganmala megidapsunnad.
Deun Judiomar-iba Bab-Dummad-Israel-Dulemar-Egiptogi-Wilebukwa-Onosad-Iba bato omosad. Bukidar neggwebur-baid-baidginmalad Jerusalénse iduakwasaar nonimalad, adi na san swilidik imakmalagar.
A-dulemar Jesús-amiarmarsunnad, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi bukmargu, na muchub-muchub egisnanai-guarmalad: —Be dakgua, ¿Jesús ibase nonikosur be dake?
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, degi, Fariseomar, igar-mesismalad, ar doa-dule wis-dibeye bia Jesús gudiiye, sogmaloye, adi Jesús-gamalagar.
